result.headline: Worth a closer look
result.basis_label: From figures you entered; not checked against bills

used.text: A full year of figures you entered (June 2025 to May 2026) shows $38,359 a year in energy costs. We haven't checked them against your bills.
Energy use is 68.0 kBtu per square foot a year. A typical office building uses 52.9, so this building uses 1.29 times as much (above typical).
Electricity costs $0.188 per kWh, well above the Tennessee average of $0.1205 for businesses.

summary.means: Your building spends a significant amount on energy and uses more than similar buildings. A short conversation with Catholic Energies could show where the energy goes.
summary.next: We'll be in touch to talk it through. This is a first look, not an energy assessment.
summary.note: kBtu (a thousand British thermal units) is a standard unit that lets electricity and gas be added together.

result.honesty_line: This is a quick first look to help decide where to spend time. It is not an energy assessment, and it does not estimate savings.
